description: Capabilities for the panel window. Deliberately minimal: the front end reaches everything through this crate's own commands, and no filesystem, shell, http or dialog plugin permission is granted. Note that this is not the whole of what the app can do - open_link spawns /usr/bin/open through std::process, outside the capability system entirely, and what holds that line is the allowlist inside the command, which takes a name rather than a URL.
